_real_world.class: Chin-mounted surface-search radar, designation not publicly disclosed
_real_world.variant_scope: Z-20F naval ASW/utility helicopter surface-search radar
public_equipment: Chin surface-search radar (FlightGlobal, B); 'large surface-search radar within a distinctive radome' confirmed by imagery (Military Watch, Defence Security Asia); designation and detection-range figures not public

_provenance.modeling_note: Surface-search radar for Z-20F per the task's requirement. No PRC designation or performance figures are public for this radar; multiple B-tier imagery-based sources (FlightGlobal, Military Watch, Defence Security Asia) confirm only its physical presence and general surface-search role, comparable functionally to the MH-60R's APS-153. All numeric fields are engineering_estimate proxies copied from the repo CSG_US_APS-153 record (aircraft/modules/sensors/csg/us/aps_153.json), the closest analogous naval-helicopter surface-search radar in the database, since Z-20F's mission profile (naval ASW/utility helicopter, chin-mounted surface-search radar) closely parallels the MH-60R's APS-153 fit and no Z-20F-specific figures exist to differentiate them.
